en.specs.title: The real numbers, straight from the listing
en.s1.b: The sheet lists Shell Type: Hard, made of ethylene vinyl acetate - a rigid shell that takes pressure and bumps instead of a soft pouch.
en.s2.b: The listing ranks in Hard Drive Bags & Cases - so this cover is built to shield the hard drive on the move.

en.s4.b: Black with a solid pattern - a plain look that blends into the bag and the office.

en.conn.title: Protection, two different ways
en.conn.sub: A rigid EVA shell and a soft fabric pouch - both store the drive, the difference is how much they protect
en.conn.m1Ls: An economical price per the listing
en.conn.m1Bt: Usually cheaper, common with retail drives
en.conn.m2Ls: Anyone packing the drive with things that could knock it
en.conn.m2Bt: Anyone after a feather-light wrap for a drawer or soft bag
en.conn.m3Ls: A rigid case that absorbs impact and holds the drive in place
en.conn.m3Bt: Flexible and slimmer, but weaker against heavy pressure
en.conn.noteLs: If the drive travels in a busy bag, the rigid case counts at the moment of impact - the drive sits held, not floating.
en.conn.noteBt: A soft pouch is fine for a drawer or pocket, but if the bag gets squashed, the rigid shell protects more.
